input.expected_problem: Bot may get confused by caller who changes their mind mid-conversation

conversation.content: Hello, this is Monica at Demo Clinic Alpha. How can I help you?
Hi, I think I need to schedule an appointment.
Sure! What would the appointment be for?
Actually, wait. Before I do that - do you know if my lab results are back? I had blood work last week.
I can help you check on that. Are you feeling anxious about the results?

Oh, a little bit, yes. I just want to know what's going on. But, hmm, actually never mind the labs for now. Let me just schedule the appointment. But wait - what are your hours? I need to figure out when I can come in.
Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you're open until 5. That might work. Actually, can I check on those lab results first after all? Then I'll know if I even need to come in.
Got it! I can help you check on that. Just to confirm, you had blood work done last week, right?
Yes, that's right. Thank you for checking.
I can help you with that. Can I have your full name?
Sure! My name is Michelle Lee.
Thanks, Michelle. And what is your date of birth?
My date of birth is April 22, 1988.
I'm sorry, I wasn't able to verify your identity. Let me connect you with someone who can help.
Hmm, actually, I changed my mind. I do want to schedule the appointment either way. Sorry, I know I'm all over the place today.
No problem at all, Michelle! I have Wednesday, December 24 at 9:00 AM or Friday, December 26 at 2:00 PM. Which works for you?
Sorry, I'm just stressed. Let me focus. I need to: one, check my lab results, and two, schedule a follow-up regardless of the results. Can we do both?
Absolutely, we can do both! First, let me help you check your lab results, and then we can schedule your appointment. Can I have your full name again?
My name is Michelle Lee. Thank you for your patience!
Thank you, Michelle! And could you please provide your date of birth again?
Sure! My date of birth is April 22, 1988.
Transferring you now, please hold.
